notes:
Passed on the fake backend with python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: a direct Driver over Tektronix_TBS2000B_control.oscilloscope_control:Oscilloscope instead of the card's ScpiDriver, because each upstream Measure* method writes a source command, writes a measurement-type command and then queries :MEASUrement:IMMed:VALue? (oscilloscope_control.py:106-134); a ScpiDriver read is one query and cannot express that sequence without merging the lines. The driver calls the upstream methods themselves, and native.py opens the same upstream class for hardware. NOT COVERED: the waveform arrays returned by Sampling; the clone's comment names 1 to 2500 samples as a full waveform (oscilloscope_control.py:56-58). MeasureLow is not exposed because the upstream implementation formats a stray '}' and iterates the characters of its channel argument (oscilloscope_control.py:136-144). The scalar functions covered are the immediate frequency, amplitude and high-level measurements and the CH1-to-CH4 channel selection. The fake replies are test data marked with a placeholder comment and are not facts, limits or references. No hardware was attached or run. The package is model-authored and unreviewed (reviewed_by null); the device is a measurement-only R1 oscilloscope and the e-stop closes the pyvisa session through the upstream Close (oscilloscope_control.py:178-180). The last gate run reported no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings and used no catalogue extension id. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-10-30; reviewed_by stays null): accepted; the reviewer changed no file of the package. The DEVIATION FROM THE CARD is accepted: a registry override now makes the card a direct driver. After the registry rebuild refreshed task.json, the reviewer re-ran the gate and wrote its digest above.
